description:
Which homeowners' association (HOA / POA / condo association) may govern an address, from the official state
        registries: Texas (TREC HOA management certificates, matched by ZIP code and the subdivision words in the appraisal
        district's legal description) and Utah (Department of Commerce HOA Registry, matched through the Utah County
        subdivision name). `address`: full street address with city and state. `community` (optional): the subdivision or
        community name, which ranks the candidates. Returns candidates with how each matched, the management certificate PDF
        (Texas) or registration number, status, expiry and management company (Utah). Candidates only: the recorded
        declaration (CC&Rs) on the lot decides. Other states: status 'unsupported' with guidance.
name: hoa_lookup
